ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name Pumpwise (Pumpwise Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.pumpwise.example
Location Pune, Maharashtra
Incorporated October 2025
One-line description Plug-on vibration and heat sensors with anomaly alerts for motors and
pumps in small factories.
Sector (as selected) Deeptech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 7 (2 founders, 3 engineers, 2 field staff)
Founders
Founder 1 Karthik Subramanian, CEO. IIT Madras, mechanical engineering. 5 years
as a reliability engineer at an engine maker. linkedin.com/in/karthik-
subramanian-example
Founder 2 Neeraj Pillai, CTO. 4 years in embedded systems at an auto-components
supplier. Designed the sensor board and firmware.
linkedin.com/in/neeraj-pillai-example
Time commitment Both full-time since October 2025.
Prior startup experience None for either founder.
Equity split Founders 80%, angels 12%, ESOP 8%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A clip-on sensor measuring vibration and temperature, a gateway, and a
model that learns each motor's normal pattern in 14 days. Alerts go to
WhatsApp.
Customers 11 pilots started since March 2026. 6 converted to paid, across 140
sensors (average 23 per customer).
Revenue INR 14.2 L cumulative, of which hardware INR 13.3 L. Monthly recurring
subscription INR 1.05 L.
Customer acquisition 3 of 6 paid customers came through a cluster association, 2 through a
pump distributor, 1 direct. Cost per paid customer is about INR 73,000
(11 pilots at INR 4.4 L / 6). This excludes founder time.

Evidence of value Customers report 9 unplanned stoppages caught early during pilots,
estimated by them at INR 1.8 L average downtime cost each. These
figures are customer-reported, not audited.
Key risks Sensor accuracy across motor types, hardware supply, and longer sales
cycles in larger plants.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 2.2 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 11 Cr post-money
Existing investors INR 30 L: a INR 10 L incubator grant and two angels (INR 20 L).
Use of funds Team, sensor inventory and pilots, certification and operations.
Other investors in
conversation
Two pre-seed funds.
How did you hear about us? Public application form. Our incubator mentor also suggested we apply.
Anything else we should know?
We would value a conversation about manufacturing scale-up and calibration. Happy to share pilot data.
